notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello Pumpkin Farmers! 

The [b]full version[/b] is now released.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33743852/05bebe606d1aa60de6c880c03184658d4e934bb5.png[/img] 

In this update: 
[list]
[*] Antimatter Grenades
[*] Use a Temporal Field to speed up pumpkin growth 
[*] Play the game on 3x or even 4x speed 
[*] Get the Red Hat worth 97 billion coins
[*] And much, much more! 
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Full Release on 30th of November
notes.notes:
Hello Pumpkin Defenders!

I am pleased to announce that the full version will be released on the 30th of November. It includes: 

[list]
[*] 18 new upgrades!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33743852/e6964a76316b879f7c7348438cdc37edb6d6ff4b.png[/img]

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes:
All the new upgrades now work! 

Thanks to MyGranny4 for reporting this bug.

notes.title: New Upgrades Update
notes.notes:
Hello Pumpkin Defenders! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33743852/e6964a76316b879f7c7348438cdc37edb6d6ff4b.png[/img]

notes.title: 27th October Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello pumpkin farmers! 

In this patch: 

[list]
[*] 4 new achievements for playing the game sped up! 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when you try to take a screenshot. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused you to die when you press E.
[/list]

If there's anything programmers hate, it's bugs - that's why I made this game!  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33743852/2a6e2261d92299d3c3375b5766d1ed6f155bf4d6.png[/img]

Enjoy!
